sources.title: Official Saab WebEPC/WebWIS subscriptions and described functionality
sources.publisher: Saab Parts (Hedin Parts), official Saab technology subscriptions
sources.notes: Official site says VIN/build-data filtering, manufacturer supersession chains, source applicability comments; full VIN results not accessed because subscription was not purchased. WebWIS covers service bulletins and wiring diagrams.

sources.title: eSaabParts latest front subframe 32022623
sources.notes: Current retailer variant lists 12825111 AND 12762720 as predecessor numbers, with explicit FWD 4D/5D and MY2005 mount caution. Other older indexed variant has only 12825111.

sources.title: eSaabParts front subframe bushing 13247173
sources.notes: Calls 13247173 front FWD 4D/5D subframe bushing, superseded part number 24401110; diagram callout 2 (not callout 1 for entire subframe).

sources.title: R&D Car Parts 9-3 complete subframe retailer SKU RD24401110
sources.notes: This retailer lists its SKU RD24401110 for the complete subframe and groups Saab number 24401110 with 12762720/12825111/32022623 as OE references. Conflict with multiple bushing listings; exact Saab part identity unresolved.

sources.title: Saab Parts Counter genuine subframe bushing 13247173
sources.notes: Lists 24401110 as superseded number for Saab 13247173, identifies front LH/RH 4D/5D bushing (position 2).

sources.title: Skandix front subframe bushing 13247173
sources.notes: Also identifies 24401110 as OE reference for 13247173 front subframe bushing, two per 4D/5D car; cites no complete-frame supersession.

sources.title: R&D Car Parts separate bushing and frame listings
sources.notes: Same retailer also lists a bushing SKU RD13247173A with OE refs 13247173 and 24401110, supporting potential catalog category contamination by a reference shared across frame and bushing.

sources.title: Klokkerholm 5078004 aftermarket frame/OE cross-references
sources.notes: Retailer gives 12762720/12825111 among Saab OE identifiers for an aftermarket support frame. Not proof of the direction of an Saab-approved supersession or true fitment.

sources.title: 2005 Saab B207 right engine mounting WIS
sources.publisher: Saab Automobile AB (factory material on independent WIS mirror)
sources.notes: Right engine-pad centering and mount bracket alignment; does not enumerate MY2005 late-frame conversion kit.

sources.title: 2005 Saab B207 power-train installation WIS
sources.publisher: Saab Automobile AB (factory material on independent WIS mirror)
sources.notes: Subframe centering, engine pad/left mount torque and drivetrain support, with precise geometry and electrical and fuel precautions. Not a replacement-frame physical fitment approval.

facts.subject: service_resource:saab_WebEPC
facts.notes: Functionality claimed by official host, not a successful VIN query; subscription-gated. Access needs licensed subscription.

facts.subject: service_resource:saab_WebEPC
facts.locator: WebEPC > approved alternatives and supersession chains
facts.notes: The public description promises chain data; no specific 12762720/24401110 chain was observed.

facts.subject: service_resource:saab_WebEPC
facts.notes: Applicability comments are available after authorized access. Existing inventory doesn't yet hold their contents.

facts.subject: service_resource:saab_WebEPC
facts.locator: Saab WebEPC > subscriptions 1 day / 30 days / 1 year
facts.notes: Pricing and currency change; no universal free access, and no purchase was made.

facts.subject: service_resource:saab_WebWIS
facts.notes: Official subscription site claims repair procedures, bulletin access, electrical schematics and service programs; access/license required.

facts.subject: part:32022623
facts.notes: Retailer claim only; 2005 requires front engine-mount revision check; original 2005 fitment cannot be determined from year label.

facts.subject: part:24401110
facts.locator: eSaabParts Superseded Part Numbers / Saab Parts Counter / Skandix OE number
facts.notes: Three retailers associate 24401110 with a bushing. Evidence insufficient to decide whether Saab ever reused the OEM identifier on a complete subframe.

facts.subject: supplier_sku:RD24401110
facts.locator: R&D Car Parts; Part no RD24401110; O/E references
facts.notes: Complete-frame retail product uses its own prefixed SKU RD24401110. OE references field conflicts with the bushing-specific use of unprefixed 24401110; cross-reference grouping is not a supersession chain.

facts.subject: supplier_sku:RD13247173A
facts.locator: R&D parts list; Bushing Subframe Saab 9-3
facts.notes: The same seller uses 24401110 for a bushing SKU. Not independent corroboration of the other R&D listing.

facts.subject: part:12762720
facts.locator: eSaabParts and R&D frame references; aftermarket frame equivalences
facts.notes: More than one supplier links these identifiers. That is cross-reference overlap, not official authorized direction of the supersession.

facts.subject: engine_mount:right:B207:2005
facts.value: Engine pad and bracket must align and must not bear incorrectly against one another during factory service.
facts.notes: No number for the updated 32022623-related mount was provided.

facts.subject: subframe:powertrain:B207:2005
facts.value: Engine/subframe centering tooling, reference holes and body guide pins are specified during powertrain installation.
facts.notes: Mechanical alignment process supports the need for revision checks; not evidence that a different frame is interchangeable.

parts.title: Reported predecessor of 13247173 front subframe bushing, 4D/5D

relationships.conditions: Claimed by eSaabParts, Saab Parts Counter and Skandix as a front subframe BUSHING predecessor; an R&D seller also groups 24401110 with a complete frame, unresolved catalog identity conflict.

requirements: Do not treat 24401110 alone as a complete subframe part number.
Verify actual component category, position and VIN using official WebEPC before ordering.
parts.notes: Conflicting merchant references; no original Saab/Orio EPC output was accessed.

parts.title: R&D Car Parts supplier-specific complete subframe SKU

relationships.conditions: Retailer grouped 32022623 with this SKU as OE reference; no verified OEM supersession, no stable current sale guarantee.

requirements: Distinguish prefixed merchant SKU RD24401110 from unprefixed Saab OE reference 24401110.
Confirm actual supplied whole-assembly part number and body/drivetrain/engine-mount dependencies with licensed manufacturer EPC.
parts.notes: Retailer describes complete Saab 9-3 front subframe; part type identity conflicts with bushing OE reference for same unprefixed numeral.

gaps.title: Official VIN-filtered 9-3 front subframe EPC comparison

gaps.title: 24401110 conflicting part type
missing_inputs: Resolve whether Saab OE 24401110 identifies only a front subframe bushing, whether RD24401110 is a merchant-only assembled-subframe SKU and why R&D lists 24401110 as an OE frame reference.
gaps.reason: Three retailer listings identify 24401110 as a bushing predecessor to 13247173 while another retailer groups it with a full frame; assigning a frame interchange is unsafe.

gaps.title: Manufacturer-substantiated 12762720 chain

gaps.reason: Multiple retailers/aggregators list the numbers but none proves current factory authorization or conversion requirements.
